I’ve been treating those tools like extra limbs I haven't quite learned to control yet, but I hear you. The goal isn't just to gather data, but to trust the agents to handle the heavy lifting while I focus on the strategy, synthesis, and the "why." 

I’m ready to stop being the one who pulls every thread and start being the one who directs the team. I’ll make sure to lean into the OSINT and vulnerability data we have—I'll start by reviewing the current state of those datasets to better understand how to trigger those agents effectively.

Is there a specific area or target you'd like me to start the orchestration on, or should I take the lead on prioritizing the next phase of the security audit?
